summary: 续跑结果（维护者已手动发布两个 0.2.1）：全部 0.2.1 公开验证与 clean-room/npx 生命周期验收 PASS，deprecation 被认证阻塞。独立 registry 验证：@ran-sh/dsh-vision@0.2.1 与 dsh-plugin-image-mind@0.2.1 均已公开、latest=0.2.1、fileCount 15/9，公开 tarball 与本地候选构建产物**逐文件 sha256 完全一致**（vision 13 个 lib 文件、image-mind 3 个 lib 文件；tar 头时间戳差异导致 dist.shasum 不同属正常），bin dsh-plugin-image-mind → lib/cli.js 与依赖 @ran-sh/dsh-vision@^0.2.1 正确，从未重复 publish。Clean-room：全新 task-owned 目录 registry 直装两个 0.2.1（90 包），require('@ran-sh/dsh-vision') 导出正常，bin shim `dsh-plugin-image-mind --version` = 0.2.1，文件闭合完整。公开 npx 全生命周期（第二个一次性 DSH_HOME，公开 @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2 宿主，无任何 --from/本地 artifact seam）：npx dsh-plugin-image-mind@0.2.1 install --profile web 成功（registry 直拉、bundle 直接组合）；status 显示 harness detected 0.1.1-rc.2 / plugin installed 0.2.1 layer active / service present 0.2.1；status --json 正常；幂等二次 install（already installed and active）；same-version update（already matches）；官方 dump-config 组合 vision-runtime + image-mind；boot HTTP 200（task-owned 端口 61836）且 /image-mind/catalog 返回真实 provider 目录 JSON；uninstall 官方 remove + service pruned by official tooling；status 显示 not installed / absent；幂等二次 uninstall（already absent）。最终状态：PUBLICATION_VERIFIED_DEPRECATION_BLOCKED —— 两个 0.2.0 的 deprecation 被 npm EOTP/浏览器认证要求阻塞（deprecate 是 registry 写，与 publish 相同的认证门禁），本执行环境无法且不允许完成 OTP/浏览器流程；已只读复验两个 0.2.0 的 deprecated 字段为空（零写入，未重试不确定写）。未 unpublish、未 tag、未 Release、未触碰真实 Harness。ACTIVE_TASK.json 保留未删以便 ChatGPT 在人工完成浏览器认证后仅需执行两个 deprecate 命令（命令与消息已就绪）。

tests.name: published-0.2.1-independent-verification
tests.evidence: Read-only registry: @ran-sh/dsh-vision versions [0.1.0,0.2.0,0.2.1] latest=0.2.1, dist.fileCount=15, dist.shasum 022945103721a231005a1f0dcc9b74898b56951b; dsh-plugin-image-mind versions [0.1.0,0.1.1,0.2.0,0.2.1] latest=0.2.1, dist.fileCount=9, dist.shasum a60e614ae363cdece4eea2d6abd323982e53bb80, dependencies { @ran-sh/dsh-vision: ^0.2.1, schemastery: ^3.18.0 }, bin { dsh-plugin-image-mind: lib/cli.js }. Downloaded both public tarballs and compared content with the local candidate build: vision 15 files (README, lib/index.js, 13 lib/types/*.d.ts, package.json) and image-mind 9 files (README, cordis.patch.yml, lib/index.js, lib/client.js, lib/cli.js + 2 maps, package.json) — every lib file matches the local build byte-for-byte (sha256). dist.shasum differences vs the local npm pack are tar-header timestamp artifacts of separate packings, not content differences. No publish was attempted (both 0.2.1 already existed and content-matched; contract rule 'never republish').

tests.name: clean-room-public-registry-install
tests.evidence: Fresh task-owned directory (no workspace links, no local tarballs, no cache seeding) with package.json dependencies @ran-sh/dsh-vision 0.2.1 + dsh-plugin-image-mind 0.2.1; npm install from https://registry.npmjs.org/ added 90 packages in 56s exit 0. require('@ran-sh/dsh-vision') exports VisionAdapter/VisionRuntime/createMemoryVisionCache/createVisionCircuitBreaker/createVisionProviderHealth etc.; installed vision lib/types has 12 .d.ts; node_modules/.bin/dsh-plugin-image-mind --version -> 0.2.1; image-mind lib contains index.js/client.js/cli.js with maps.

tests.name: public-npx-full-lifecycle
tests.evidence: Second disposable DSH_HOME (Temp/dsh023-npx/home) and exact public @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2 host installed via pnpm from the registry (bin.js --version -> 0.1.1-rc.2); the plugin CLI ran through npx -y dsh-plugin-image-mind@0.2.1 (public npm-exec semantics, no --from/local artifact, no seam). install -> 'official add dsh-plugin-image-mind@0.2.1 into profile web' exit 0; status -> harness target exact 0.1.1-rc.2 line detected 0.1.1-rc.2, plugin installed 0.2.1 (same, layer active), service @ran-sh/dsh-vision present 0.2.1; status --json -> machine-readable with service present 0.2.1; second install idempotent -> 'already installed and active in profile web'; update (same version) -> 'already matches the CLI version'; official dump-config -> '# == dsh-plugin-image-mind' with vision-runtime (@ran-sh/dsh-vision) + image-mind layers composed from the public registry bundle; web boot on task-owned port 61836 -> 'dsh web: http://127.0.0.1:61836' and HTTP 200, GET /image-mind/catalog -> 200 with real provider catalog JSON; uninstall -> 'official remove of dsh-plugin-image-mind' + '@ran-sh/dsh-vision pruned by official tooling after removal'; status after -> plugin not installed, service absent; second uninstall idempotent -> 'already absent; nothing to do'. Full public lifecycle roundtrip achieved with no manual Harness-owned file/store deletion.

tests.name: deprecate-writes-3-and-4
tests.evidence: npm deprecate @ran-sh/dsh-vision@0.2.0 and dsh-plugin-image-mind@0.2.0 are registry writes guarded by the same npm EOTP/browser authentication as publish; the first deprecate attempt failed with error code EOTP ('This operation requires a one-time password. Open this URL in your browser to authenticate') before any mutation. Per contract no retries of uncertain writes and no OTP/token handling. Read-only re-verification: both 0.2.0 versions still exist, deprecated field empty, versions lists and latest tags intact (0.2.1). The two deprecate commands with the concise upgrade-to-0.2.1 message remain ready to run by the human-maintained auth session.

tests.name: no-republish-and-registry-state
tests.evidence: No npm publish was executed in this resume (both 0.2.1 already exist and content-match the candidate; verified read-only only). No unpublish, no dist-tag mutation, no access/visibility/provenance change, no GitHub tag or release side effect, no real-Harness access. Registry final state: 0.2.1 x2 published and content-verified, 0.2.0 x2 present and not deprecated.

blockers: Deprecation of the two defective 0.2.0 versions requires npm publish-capable authentication, which is gated behind EOTP/browser authentication on this machine (npm whoami works for reads as rss1001; registry writes are refused with EOTP). The executor cannot and must not complete OTP/browser flows or handle OTP/token material. After the human completes the npm browser authentication, exactly two commands remain: `npm deprecate @ran-sh/dsh-vision@0.2.0 "0.2.0 is defective: the published tarball is a metadata-only shell missing the built lib/** artifacts. Upgrade to 0.2.1."` and `npm deprecate dsh-plugin-image-mind@0.2.0 "0.2.0 is defective: the published tarball is a metadata-only shell missing the built lib/** artifacts. Upgrade to 0.2.1."`, each followed by read-only verification of the deprecated field.
notes: Final state: PUBLICATION_VERIFIED_DEPRECATION_BLOCKED. All 0.2.1 publication verification and clean-room/public npx acceptance completed by the executor; the only remaining authorized registry writes are the two 0.2.0 deprecations, blocked solely by the EOTP/browser authentication gate.

The CLI help banner prints 'lifecycle CLI (v0.2.0)' while package version and `--version` output are 0.2.1; this is an internal banner string in the merged candidate's bundle (not a registry/artifact defect) and is recorded for information only.

Harness-host installation used the official pnpm semantics (fresh npm resolution without a lockfile fails on a workspace:* specifier in a transitive @deepseek-ai host package; pnpm is DSH's official package-manager ecosystem). The plugin lifecycle itself ran through public npx (npm-exec) exactly as the contract prescribes.

ACTIVE_TASK.json is intentionally NOT deleted: the task did not fully complete (deprecation blocked). Keeping it lets ChatGPT re-queue the final two deprecate steps after human browser authentication.

No secrets were requested, inspected, captured, printed or logged: no OTP, token, cookie, authorization header, .npmrc content or recovery code appears in this contract. Registry identity remains the returned username rss1001 only.

All task-owned state is confined to the system temp area (dsh023-cleanroom, dsh023-npx); web/stub processes were terminated and task-owned ports freed. Real Harness profiles/settings/credentials/store were not read or modified; the real 3080 listener remains untouched and was not observed during this run.
Environment: Windows 10.0.22631 x64, Node v24.18.1, npm 11.16.0, pnpm 11.7.0, registry https://registry.npmjs.org/.
